Welcome to #HorseHour on YouTube, Time for You and Your Horse! 

Go to www.horsehour.co.uk for more videos, podcasts and articles on everything equestrian. 

Join everyone on Twitter for #HorseHour, a weekly networking hour on where riders, owners, businesses and charities from across the globe come together to share experiences, advise and advertise. Mondays 8pm UK time/3pm EST. Just search for #HorseHour!
